current_phase.next_action: Optional browser/manual pass only: verify the add and edit reservation forms on the user's real trip at desktop and mobile widths. Programmatic implementation and verification are complete.

reported_bug.user_summary: I have an issue where I cannot make another reservation.
reported_bug.resolved_summary: The reservation add and edit flows now show field-level validation errors, a top-of-form summary, a toast on validation failure, and focus/scroll to the first invalid field. Freeform timezone inputs were replaced with the shared TimezonePicker and server validation now checks against the same IANA identifier list used by the UI.

audit_findings.finding: The original form rendered InputError only for title while the controller validated type, provider_name, booking_reference, status, dates, timezones, contact fields, notes, flight fields, lodging fields, and flight_details.
audit_findings.fix: Every visible add-reservation field now has a matching name or data-error-target plus an InputError.

audit_findings.finding: The edit flow used router.patch and page-level errors, but the reservation edit template did not expose most server validation failures.
audit_findings.fix: The edit reservation form now renders FormErrorSummary and field-level InputError messages, including nested flight_details fields.

audit_findings.finding: Freeform timezone text inputs made shorthand values like PST or misspellings a silent 422 path.
audit_findings.fix: Reservation create/edit forms now use TimezonePicker backed by a shared Inertia timezones prop sourced from DateTimeZone::listIdentifiers().

audit_findings.finding: after_or_equal:starts_at compared wall-clock input values without applying each field's timezone.
audit_findings.fix: EndsAtAfterStarts compares start and end instants with Carbon using the selected start and end timezones.

audit_findings.finding: Validation, session expiry, and network failures had weak feedback paths for the reservation workflow.
audit_findings.fix: The local post and patch flows now toast on validation errors. The global Inertia flash toast initializer handles 419 httpException events and networkError events.

confirmed_paths: Missing reservation title returns a visible validation error contract.
Invalid timezone value PST is rejected.
End instant before start instant is rejected after timezone-aware comparison.
Cross-timezone flight with valid instant order is accepted.
Lowercase flight_details.currency is normalized to uppercase before save.
not_captured: No live browser screenshots were captured in ai/audit/reservation-create-2026-05-18/ during this implementation pass.

decisions_locked_in: Every reservation input that maps to a server rule gets its own InputError.
FormErrorSummary appears at the top of both add and edit reservation forms.
Failed reservation create/edit submissions call scrollToFirstError and show a toast saying: Couldn't save - check the highlighted fields.
Freeform timezone inputs are replaced by the shared TimezonePicker component.
The timezone option list is shipped through HandleInertiaRequests as timezones and cached forever.
after_or_equal:starts_at is replaced by EndsAtAfterStarts for timezone-aware instant comparison.
419 session expiry is handled globally through the Inertia httpException event.
No new database columns were added.
Lowercase flight_details.currency is normalized server-side instead of rejected.

open_questions.question: Where do edit-form errors land?
open_questions.answer: patchEdit uses router.patch, so errors are read from page.props.errors while editing a reservation.

open_questions.question: Does the project already have toast support?
open_questions.answer: Yes. resources/js/lib/flashToast.ts uses vue-sonner and was extended for 419 and network errors.

open_questions.question: Is there an existing combobox to reuse?
open_questions.answer: No reservation-specific combobox was needed. The trip-timezones stack already introduced resources/js/components/TimezonePicker.vue, which this module reuses.

open_questions.question: Does ConvertEmptyStringsToNull remain enabled?
open_questions.answer: bootstrap/app.php does not remove Laravel's default ConvertEmptyStringsToNull middleware behavior.

regression_watch: The shared post() helper on Trips/Show.vue now adds onError behavior for every local form using that helper.
TimezonePicker and shared timezones prop were introduced by the trip-timezones stack; keep these modules together when reviewing or committing.
No route changes were added by reservation-create, but npm run build regenerated Wayfinder artifacts successfully.
